home.inProgress: Your session is waiting where you left it.
home.restBody: Enjoy the rest, or pick a workout from your library if you feel like moving.
home.firstBody: Make your first workout in the library, then plan it for a day.
home.somethingElse: Something else? Pick from your library
home.discardBody: It won’t show in your history or your totals. This can’t be undone.

library.nothingHint: Try another word, or look in the exercises to build one.
library.emptyBody: Build one once, then plan it for any day or keep it here for later.

workout.plannedDays: {days, plural, one {Planned on # day} other {Planned on # days}}

plan.title: Plan {name}
plan.hint: Tap the days to train it. Tap again to take one off.

exercises.nothingHint: Try one word, a muscle like “glutes”, or something you own like “dumbbell”.
exercises.noFitHint: Try another muscle, or tick more of what you have.
exercises.equipmentHint: Tick what you have to list the exercises that use it.

exercise.variationsHint: Easiest at the top, hardest at the bottom.

builder.name: Name
builder.tapToType: tap a value to type it
builder.valueInvalid: This can’t be read. Type a value like the quick picks below.
builder.addToRepeat: Add a step to this repeat
builder.formatSubtitle: You choose once: the format stays for this workout.
builder.circuitDescription: Rounds through several exercises, each done once per round. Fits HIIT, bodyweight circuits and runs.
builder.setsDescription: One exercise at a time: all its sets, then the next. Fits gym and strength training.
builder.addPartSubtitle: Parts run in order: warm-up, work, cool down.
builder.circuitHint: A circuit has no sets: the repeat around it sets the rounds.
builder.setsHint: Rest between sets shows from 2 sets. A walk or a run has no sets.

player.summary: {done, number} of {planned, number} sets done in {duration}
player.stopBody: What you did so far is kept.

history.emptyBody: Finish a workout or a treadmill session and it will show up here.
history.deleteBody: It leaves your history and stats. This can’t be undone.
history.activeDays: {days, plural, one {# active day · swipe for other months} other {# active days · swipe for other months}}
history.resting: No session that day. Poulpy was resting too.

live.emptyBody: Switch on your treadmill, pod or band. Poulpy connects to the ones you added as soon as they are nearby.
live.modeAuto: Auto: starts, pauses and stops with the treadmill
live.modeManual: Manual: you start and stop the recording
live.modeInfo: With the sync button on, Start waits for the belt to move. Pausing the treadmill pauses the recording, and Stop on the console finishes it. If the belt stays still or the treadmill disconnects for a while, you’re asked whether to finish. With it off, you start, pause and stop here.
live.finishStillBody: The belt stopped {stoppedMinutes, number} min ago. With no answer, Poulpy finishes the session in {finishMinutes, number} min, ending it at {endTime}.
live.finishStoppedBody: You stopped the treadmill. Start it again to carry on, even with another program. With no answer, Poulpy finishes the session in {finishMinutes, number} min, ending it at {endTime}.
live.finishLostBody: It disconnected {lostMinutes, number} min ago and Poulpy keeps trying. With no answer, the session finishes in {finishMinutes, number} min, ending at {endTime}, when it was last seen.
live.finishClosedBody: The app closed during your session, and Poulpy kept the first {endTime}. If you don’t answer, it ends there in {finishMinutes, number} min.
live.notificationChannelInfo: Shows while Live records a session, so it keeps going with the screen off or another app open.

settings.themeHint: System follows your phone’s light or dark mode.
settings.unitsHint: Metric: km and km/h. Imperial: miles and mph. Weights stay in kg for now.
settings.languageNextLaunch: A new language shows the next time you open the app.

devices.emptyBody: Add your treadmill, a foot pod or a heart rate band. Poulpy shows their numbers together while you run, and records the session.
devices.forgetBody: Poulpy stops connecting to it. You can add it again later.
devices.autoConnectHint: When the app opens and it is nearby
devices.sourcesHint: When two devices measure the same thing, pick the one to trust. Automatic prefers what is on your body: the pod over the treadmill, the band over the treadmill’s grips.
devices.scanHint: Treadmills, foot pods and heart rate bands. Wake your device up and stay close to it.
devices.addedHidden: Devices you already added are not listed here.
devices.permissionNeeded: Allow Bluetooth access so the app can find your devices.
devices.bluetoothOff: Bluetooth is off. Turn it on to connect to your devices.

kind.unknown: Unknown device, tried as a treadmill

import.title: Add this workout?
import.note: It is added as a copy in your library. Nothing you already have changes.
import.nothingAdded: Nothing was added to your library.
